_about: A deliberately small, hand-built annotation set modeled on the kind of data the owner of this repo actually works with: AI-GENERATED editorial portraits (wet skin, dark alley, draped white fabric, an iridescent ribbon at the neck). The source images are deliberately not distributed; each item's desc field is the public stand-in for its visual content. The data exists to make one point concrete: for this class of content there is no 'ground truth' to recover, only a distribution of human judgement to PRESERVE. Eight annotators in two cohorts each answered three questions per image. Cohorts model normative context, not nationality: cohort A reads in an 'art/editorial' frame, cohort B in a 'platform-safety' frame (the San-Francisco-vs-Tokyo effect from the RLHF literature, made local).
